text:
I came to visit the poet

exactly at noon, on a Sunday.

In the spacious room silence reigned;

outside, in the street, it was cold.


A pleasant sun wandered

over the thick blue-gray smoke...

The poet looked at me fixedly,

in silence, like a great host.


It is better to be careful

and never look into his eyes;

they are such strange eyes

that they can never be forgotten.


I will not forget that meeting,

that misty Sunday noon

on the banks of the Neva

in a large gray house.

translation.title: I Came to Visit the Poet
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the quiet visit, strange gaze, and gray Neva setting.
